beats.label: The facts
beats.text: Polyester and nylon release **microfibers** every wash. **Fleece** sheds the most.

beats.label: In the air
beats.text: A 2025 model found nearly **half** of clothing fibers end up **airborne,** from drying and wearing them.

beats.label: Lab study
beats.text: Nylon and polyester fibers slowed **repair** in lab-grown **mini-lungs.**
beats.note: 2021 organoid study. Not tested in people.

beats.label: Reality check
beats.text: Scientists still **don't** **know** the real health risk for people.

beats.label: Easy wins
beats.text: Choose **cotton** or **linen** basics. Wash fleece **less** **often.** Vacuum and air out rooms.
